required_records: effective final polyMesh points, faces, owner, neighbour and boundary, including mesh instance times
final cell centres and velocity field with row/label identity
tetBasePtIs and ordered cellTetIndices for the witness segment neighbourhood
tet vertex coordinates, determinant values, fallback/warning counters and numerical small threshold
volPointInterpolation point values shared by the selected cells
cellPoint scheme selection and direct centre/face/segment evaluations
binary/package hashes and matching source files for interpolation paths
raw data hashes and original-manifest link
acceptance_conditions: verify conforming shared-face triangles and finite shared point values
verify no degenerate fallback or ambiguous tetrahedron search along the witnessed segment
verify centre interpolation and account for floating discrepancies in endpoint bounds
preserve old source/inputs; perform a prospective successor run rather than change old archives
quality_gate: No new solver quality verdict until conditions and interpretation are checked
